storyTitle: A little set of stairs made the next job easier.
description: Before the cabin walls, the storage shed needed a better way in.
noteHtml:
But before we could get to the walls, we needed stairs on that ugly green storage shed.

Nothing fancy, just one of those practical little jobs that instantly makes everything around it work better.
